Name: (CP)(FF) Retro Style Furniture
Author: Novaphene
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/7DxaSXe.png[/img]
As most of players know, this was previously made with DGA. With it no longer supported, I have decided to migrate to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Leroymilo/about-me?gameId=1303]Leroymilo[/url]. 
This is an FF (furniture framework) conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16029]Nano's Retro Style Furniture[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HmfUsq0.png[/img]
[i]1. furniture items are accessible using "Novaphene's Catalogue" available at Robin's shop! [/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lqRrBO3.png[/img]
[i]2. [b]You can switch to the other catalogue design[/b] by going to [CP] [FF] Retro Style Furniture/ [FF] Retro Furniture/ assets and [b]renaming[/b] the catalogue_2 to catalogue. 
[i] [img]https://i.imgur.com/uoli4ES.png[/img][/i][/i]
[i]3. added rotations for a few furniture items
4. added more '[b]slots[/b]' for tables such as coffee table and dining tables
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3PvxSec.png[/img]
[/spoiler]
4. no slots for decorated tables such as this 
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CLDRTBs.png[/img]
[/spoiler]

[i]- [b]fixed [/b]bed issue (where sleep dialogue is not prompted)
[spoiler][img]https://i.imgur.com/MY7t58H.png[/img][/spoiler][/i]

A big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/62992811]NanoIsNotRobot[/url] for giving permission for the conversion and few modifications of the pieces. Her works are very neat and charming so please check out her other mods!

Also thank you so much, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Leroymilo/about-me?gameId=1303]Leroymilo[/url]﻿, for helping me during this process. Thanks to your efforts, I was able to update this mod! 

[i][b]Changelog 3.0: [/b][/i]
Big kudos to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/maniekrate/about-me?gameId=1303]maniekrate [/url]for looking through a set of decorations that I forgot to add in the game! FF Rretro Style Furniture/assets/decoration/Decorations. I was so tired during the making of this mod that I forgot to look through everything if I missed something. TuT  Now, it has been added in version 3.0!

[img]https://imgur.com/EwJVIBf.png[/img]
[b][color=#ffff00]>> IF THERE ARE BUGS, PLEASE POST THEM IN THE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17127?tab=bugs]BUGS SECTION[/url]﻿. DON'T FORGET TO PASTE YOUR SMAPI LOG URL. <<[/color][/b]
1. Install SMAPI
2. Download the Requirements (see 'Requirements' dropdown) which are Content Patcher and Furniture Framework.
3. Put the mods in your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder
4. Load the game

- Fixed bugs (see bugs section)

- SDV 1.6 Compatible
